name: stackdrop-functions
description: Cloud Functions for Stack Drop: names, profiles, account deletion, scores and friends.

scripts.test:rules: tsc && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-stackdrop "node --test lib/test/rules.spec.js"
scripts.test:integration: tsc && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-stackdrop "node --test --test-concurrency=1 lib/test/integration.spec.js"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration
